boards.title: Q3 Brand Refresh — 'Hire agents, not headcount'
boards.direction: Confident, editorial, high-contrast. Obsidian ground, one lime accent, no gradients. DM Sans headlines set large and tight; generous whitespace. Product-as-hero — real UI screenshots framed like objects, minimal chrome. Reference bar: Instrument / Collins, not stock SaaS. Every frame must earn its single accent.

boards.title: Voice Agent Campaign — Recruiting Demo
boards.direction: Warmer, human counterpoint to the master brand. Recruiting context — candidate + phone-call moments, real faces over illustration. Softer neutrals hold the frame; lime reserved for the CTA only. Motion-first (reels): the voice waveform is the recurring motif, before/after of a manual workflow is the payoff. Keep it earnest, never gimmicky.
